steps.note: Open the existing live RFQ with two bids on its project summary page.
Ensure the Withdraw Project action is available for the buyer.
Ensure the prepared RFQ project flow is enabled for this tenant.
Open the project's withdrawal confirmation pop-up.
Verify the withdrawal confirmation pop-up is displayed before cancellation.

args.text: Are you sure you want to withdraw this event?

steps.note: Verify the pop-up contains the expected withdrawal confirmation question.
Cancel the withdrawal instead of confirming it.
Verify the confirmation pop-up closes after cancellation.
Verify cancellation did not withdraw the event.
Verify the event remains in its live state after cancellation.
